plate_comment: low_speed_governor_reference_maximum_fuel_quantity: the steady-state and transient 4D fueling maps (e2m 1054-1059) at low_speed_governor_adjusted_reference_speed and 100 % throttle (400), blended by four_dimensional_fueling_interpolation_factor (Q14: 0 = transient, 0x4000 = steady state) (was cm848_processSpeedSensorCompensation)

Drives the tachometer outputs (e2m 116A / 116B; output channel entries 25 / 26 = e2m 1565 Tachometer_Highside / Lowside_Driver_Map): the engine speed (or tachometer_override_engine_speed in override mode 1), raised to tachometer_minimum_engine_speed when lower and nonzero, gives tachometer_signal_period = tachometer_base_period x 1000000 / speed microseconds at 50 % duty (0x3200); speed 0 (or a base period above 0x10c5) turns them off (period 0xffffffff, duty 0) (was cm848_processEngineRpmDiagnostic)

Boot initializer of the tachometer outputs: tachometer_minimum_engine_speed = tachometer_base_period x 0x1312 >> 10 (at least tachometer_engine_speed_cutoff); then enables entries 25 / 26 with period 0xffffffff and duty 0 (was cm848_dispatchCalibrationFunctions)
